whatsappMessage: Hi Areatk team, I have a question about the platform:

about.title: Areatk,
about.highlight: one place to learn, connect and organize your time
about.text: Areatk is an education-focused social platform for IT fields. It brings students and experts together in specialized communities, offers a calm space to study, and simple tools to plan your time — with no ads and no distractions.

free.title: Completely free
free.text: Every section is free for students: communities, courses, exams, study sessions and the study plan.

focus.title: Distraction-free
focus.text: Eye-friendly colors, focus sounds and videos, a study/break timer, and no ads.

trust.title: Verified experience
trust.text: The team verifies experts before granting a badge, and anyone can see their experience by tapping the shield.

languages.title: Arabic & English
languages.text: The whole platform works in both languages, with right-to-left support and search that tolerates small typos.

about.badgesTitle: Badges: how do you know who's an expert?
about.badgesText: Anyone can apply for a badge with proof (a certificate or a letter from an employer), and the team reviews it. A badge means the team verified the experience — not that everything its holder writes is correct.
about.expert: Blue shield: practical or academic experience in a specific track.
about.scholar: Green shield: academic value (doctors, trainers and certificate holders); allows publishing courses, exams and educational live streams.
about.ctaText: Create your account in a minute. Got a question or suggestion? Our team answers on WhatsApp.

privacy.title: Terms of use & privacy policy
privacy.intro: Here we explain what data we handle, where it's stored, how we use it, and the rules we all agree on to keep the platform a useful and safe place to learn.

data.title: Data we handle
points: Account data: username, email and password (stored hashed).
Profile data you choose to add: name, photo, bio, headline and university.
Content you publish: posts, questions, comments, videos, courses and exams.
Your activity: communities you joined, exam results, course progress and your study plan.

use.title: How we use your data
points: To run the platform: showing posts from your communities, saving your progress and sending notifications.
So the admin team can review badge requests, branch requests and reports.
We don't sell your data, show ads, or share it with any third party.

storage.title: Where data is stored
points: Your account data and the content you post are stored on the platform's servers, and travel between you and the platform over an encrypted connection (HTTPS).
Your password is stored hashed, so no one can read it — not even the admin team.
We keep your data while your account is active. When you delete your account, your personal data is deleted with it.
Your browser only keeps a few simple settings, like your language, light or dark mode, and staying logged in.

badges.title: Badges and proof files
points: The proof file you attach to a badge request is seen only by the admin team, never by other users.
Once approved, your experience page shows only: the badge type, your description, and the proof type (e.g. certificate).
You can delete your request while it's under review, and the proof file is deleted with it.

rules.title: Rules of use
points: Respect others and don't post offensive or inappropriate content.
No ads or spam, and don't copy others' content (courses or exams) without permission.
Check information before publishing, especially in courses and exams.
Camera and microphone are used in live streams only with your permission, and stop as soon as the live ends.

moderation.title: Reports and moderation
points: You can report any exam, course or live stream that breaks the rules.
The admin team reviews the report, decides to remove or keep the content, and notifies you of the decision.
Repeated violations may lead to losing a badge or suspending the account.

rights.title: Your rights
points: You can edit your profile anytime and delete your posts, drafts, courses and exams.
You can request a copy of your data or full account deletion by contacting us.
Your content is yours; publishing it means you agree to show it to users inside the platform.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
points: We may update this policy as the platform grows; the last-updated date appears at the top.
Continuing to use the platform after an update means you accept the new version.

privacy.contactText: Contact the support team on WhatsApp and we'll get back to you soon.
